title: Recipe not available on this node
message: The recipe {recipe} isn't available on this node: {reason}.
basic_text: This training method can't run on this computer.

title: Recipe, reward-function or required plugin not installed
message: {name} is not installed.
basic_text: Something this training needs isn't installed.
fix_text: Install the plugin that provides it.

title: No usable rows for this recipe
message: The dataset {dataset_id} has no rows the {recipe} recipe can use.
basic_text: This dataset has nothing this training method can learn from.
fix_text: Pick another dataset, or check its columns.

title: No method fits the memory budget
message: No training method for {model_name} fits the memory budget of {budget_bytes} bytes.
basic_text: This model is too big to train on this computer.
fix_text: Use a smaller model, or a computer with more memory.

title: Dataset task doesn't match the recipe
message: The dataset's task {task} doesn't match the {recipe} recipe.
basic_text: This dataset doesn't fit this training method.
fix_text: Pick a dataset or a method that match.

title: Training command not available yet
message: {command_id} isn't available in this version of Rastai yet.
basic_text: This feature is planned but not built yet in this version of Rastai.
fix_text: Nothing to fix on your side: the feature arrives in a later version.

title: Reward model accuracy below the RLHF gate
message: The reward model's accuracy is {accuracy}, below the RLHF gate of {minimum_accuracy}.
basic_text: The reward model isn't accurate enough to train with.
fix_text: Train the reward model on more or cleaner preference data.

title: Reward model base differs from the policy base
message: The reward model's base {reward_base} differs from the policy's base {policy_base}; this needs extra VRAM.
basic_text: The two models in this training are different, so it needs more graphics memory.

title: Checkpoint write failed: disk full; run paused
message: Writing a checkpoint of {run_id} failed because the disk is full; the run is paused.
basic_text: Your disk filled up while saving training progress, so the training paused.
fix_text: Free up space, then resume the run.

title: Checkpoint files don't match their recorded hashes; falling back to an older one
message: Checkpoint {checkpoint_id} doesn't match its recorded hashes; falling back to {fallback_checkpoint_id}.
basic_text: The latest saved training progress was damaged, so Rastai used an older one.

title: Resuming on a different environment or hardware
message: Resuming {run_id} on a different environment or hardware: {difference}.
basic_text: This training continues on a different setup, so results may differ slightly.

title: No complete checkpoint to resume from
message: {run_id} has no complete checkpoint to resume from.
basic_text: There is no saved training progress to continue from.

title: Checkpoint belongs to a different run
message: Checkpoint {checkpoint_id} belongs to a different run: {difference}.
basic_text: This saved progress is from another training.
fix_text: Pick a checkpoint of this run.

title: Non-finite loss or gradients, repeatedly
message: The loss or gradients of {run_id} were non-finite {count} times in a row.
basic_text: The training went unstable and stopped.
fix_text: Lower the learning rate, or check the data.

title: Policy KL above max_kl; stopped early
message: The policy's KL ({kl}) went above max_kl ({max_kl}); stopped early.
basic_text: The model drifted too far from where it started, so the training stopped.
fix_text: Lower the learning rate, or raise max_kl if the drift is expected.

title: No GGUF mapping for this family, or opaque nodes
message: {model_name} can't be exported to GGUF: {reason}.
basic_text: This model can't be exported for the fast chat engine.

title: Dataset license needs confirmation before publishing
message: The license of {dataset_id} ({license}) needs your confirmation before publishing.
basic_text: The data this model learned from has a license you should check before sharing it.

title: Export check failed
message: The export check failed: {reason}.
basic_text: The exported model doesn't give exactly the same answers as the original.

title: HF token can't write this repo
message: The Hugging Face token can't write to {repository}.
basic_text: Your Hugging Face access key isn't allowed to upload here.
fix_text: Use a token with write access to this repository.

title: HF push failed after retries
message: Pushing to {repository} failed after retries: {reason}.
basic_text: Rastai couldn't upload the model to Hugging Face.
fix_text: Check your connection and try again.

title: No Ollama template for this family; Ollama falls back to the GGUF's chat template
message: There is no Ollama template for the {family} family; Ollama falls back to the GGUF's chat template.
basic_text: Ollama will use the chat format stored in the model file.
